name: r1-a-e1-ts-fp16x3
author: solx-loop
description: For N <= 14208 tokens (all S and M rows), one cooperative tcgen05 FP16x3 launch keeps fp32 h in TMEM across per-batch GRN counters. Each CTA streams 512 KB of hi/lo weight images from L2 through a 3-stage 32 KB ring and runs about 9.2k MMA clocks plus about 10k issue clocks of epilogue. That predicts about 12-15 us rented at 12544 tokens and 6-9 us at 784 tokens, against r0's 137-221 us. UNMEASURED: the session ended before compile_b200 returned and every probe timed out.
